Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 12  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error in interpreting the death dates of the directors. The Planner incorrectly stated that Thomas N. Heffron died on 1941-10-26 and Victor Schertzinger on 1951-05-24, which is the reverse of the actual dates. This mistake led to the incorrect conclusion that Thomas N. Heffron died earlier when, in fact, Victor Schertzinger died earlier.
